inputs.prompt: Animate this exact hand-drawn 2D Japanese anime frame. Preserve ink outlines, hard-edged cel shading, flat matte skin, broad hair locks and painted gothic backgrounds throughout. Preserve identities, clothing, number of characters and established scenery. Intentional animation with anticipation, force, follow-through and settle; no loop, CGI, extra limbs, character morphing, unrelated cut, orbit or unmotivated zoom. The small whale-hooded girl starts kneeling on the floor at screen left. The acolyte's hand rests on her near shoulder, pulls upward once while she places one foot flat and pushes herself into a small unsteady standing stance. Her two feet settle onto the floor before the acolyte holds her shoulder still. The priest remains on screen right, raises his palm toward her, and a small amber light gathers slowly. No attack beam yet. The child looks up frightened, then freezes. A very small camera tilt follows her rise, keeping the priest's hand and the child's shoulder in frame. A single physical action, not dangling the child in the air, no neck grip, no duplicate arms.
